an6.118:1.1: CXVIII. Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ajjhattaṃ kāye . . . pe . . . bahiddhā kāye . . . ajjhattabahiddhā kāye . . . vedanāsu . . . ajjhattaṃ vedanāsu . . . bahiddhā vedanāsu . . . ajjhattabahiddhā vedanāsu . . . citte . . . ajjhattaṃ citte . . . bahiddhā citte . . . ajjhattabahiddhā citte . . . dhammesu . . . ajjhattaṃ dhammesu . . . bahiddhā dhammesu . . . ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharituṃ. Katame cha? Kammārāmataṃ, bhassārāmataṃ, niddārāmataṃ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ . . . Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharitun ti. CXIX.
